requirements.general: SPM / O-Level or equivalent:  A pass with at least Grade C in 5 subjects UEC: A pass with at least Grade B in 3 subjects; or its equivalence English Requirements (International Students Only): IELTS: Band 4.0 TOEFL: 5 (Ess OL) / 30-31 (iBT) Pearson: 36 Linguaskill OL: 140 ELS: 106 MUET: 3.0 Note: To progress to degree programs in specialized fields, students may need a credit in specific subjects at the SPM (or equivalent) level.
